t: Query recipe capture — Reproducible Retrieval Packager
title: Query recipe capture — Reproducible Retrieval Packager
description:
The reproducible retrieval packager makes a search replayable: it saves the query text, filters, source identifiers, ranking configuration, index versions, and timestamps into a retrieval recipe. Anyone running the recipe later gets the same result set — or a precise diff explaining what changed and why. In regulated and scientific work, 'I searched and found' is not enough; the search itself must be an artifact.

This record documents the query recipe capture approach: Serialize the full query — text, filters, facets, ranking config — into a versioned recipe file.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.

Every record in this database is the full fully-formed file with all data — never a stub or description alone. This database holds 15 of the 1,000,000 target — the march to a million is in progress.
demo:
# Reproducible Retrieval Packager demo: recipe capture, deterministic replay, diff.
import hashlib,json
INDEX=[{"id":"d1","text":"solar sails"},{"id":"d2","text":"sail boats"},{"id":"d3","text":"photon sails"}]
def run(recipe):
    q=recipe["query"]; k=recipe["k"]
    hits=sorted([d for d in INDEX if q in d["text"]],key=lambda d:d["id"])[:k]
    return [h["id"] for h in hits]
recipe={"query":"sail","k":2,"index_version":"idx-2026-10-21","ranker":"det-v1"}
r1=run(recipe)
h1=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(r1).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
print("recipe:",recipe); print("results:",r1,"hash:",h1)
INDEX.append({"id":"d0","text":"sail repair"})  # archive grew
r2=run(recipe)
print("replay after growth:",r2,"changed:",set(r1)^set(r2) or "none")
provenance: Public-harvest: documents established, real-world methods for reproducible retrieval packager; fact-checked public knowledge.

    q=recipe["query"]; k=recipe["k"]
    hits=sorted([d for d in INDEX if q in d["text"]],key=lambda d:d["id"])[:k]
    return [h["id"] for h in hits]
